title: Seagrove Beach "Avalon Sunset" 240 Lakeview Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Peloton bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Private pool *Pool heating is available for $45/day*- In-home elevator- Cornhole- Firepit- Parking for 5 vehicles. - 8 adult bikes- Backpack Chairs included - 8 Backpack Chairs and 4 umbrellas (Mar. 1 - Oct. 1)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Luxury meets comfort at Avalon Sunset, a lavish home in laid-back Seagrove Beach. With over 6,300 square feet of elegant living space, this 3-story home accommodates 28 guests in exceptional comfort, featuring 8 beautiful bedrooms, 8 full bathrooms, and 2 half baths. Revel in leisurely days spent swimming in the pool, lounging in the sitting spa, or taking in the view from the rooftop deck. Only a few blocks away are 2 beach accesses, making this home the perfect retreat for an iconic 30A vacation.Golden wood floors and natural light add depth and warmth to the pale, coastal color scheme of the impressive first-level great room. The kitchen is a chef's dream, with marble countertops and premium appliances, including 2 dishwashers for effortless cleanup. Sip pre-dinner drinks at the expansive island, boasting 5 high-backed stools, before indulging in a meal at the traditional dining area for 10. The expansive living area’s plush couches and armchairs invite relaxation, or meander out to the covered patio with an alfresco dining table and soft seating to enjoy the fresh breeze. A private pool with an attached sitting spa and a firepit promise fun beneath the sun and stars, and the outdoor kitchen provides extra comforts with a natural gas grill and beverage fridge. Guests can retire to 2 guest bedrooms with king beds down the hall near the laundry room.Utilize the in-home elevator to access the second floor, where 5 spacious bedrooms await—4 guest bedrooms with king beds and 1 bunk room with 3 queen-over-queen beds. There's also a laundry room and a wet bar for convenience.A luxurious living space with sweeping views of the lake and Gulf is on the third floor, along with a well-equipped kitchenette and Peloton bike. The top-floor guest bedroom features 2 queen beds and offers stunning views from a private porch. The highlight of this home lies on the rooftop deck, boasting bar seating, loungers, and uninterrupted panoramas of the breathtaking scenery.Experience elegance and beachside charm at Avalon Sunset in Seagrove. With on-site parking for 5 vehicles and 8 complimentary adult bikes—plus a 6-passenger low speed vehicle—it's easy to explore the local area. Sugar Dunes Beach Access is a 3-minute walk. Take Lakewood Drive west (right) to Beachside Drive, then head south (left) until the beach access is visible on the right. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 28):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Three Queen/Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only
